# Acuity Brands Deep-Dive Analysis

Report 002 | Published 2019-11-24 | Evaluated 2026-11-07

[Original member article](https://www.lynalden.com/premium-2019-11-24/) | [Article index](README.md) | [Structured review](../data/reviews/002.json)

Acuity combines cyclical lighting and longer-run controls growth.

The balance-sheet resilience argument survived its first severe stress. The ten-year return models are genuinely unresolved, while tariff and construction causal claims require more than the pandemic outcome. The review does not assign a stock-selection win from profitable operations alone.

**Coverage:** All numbered text blocks and image labels read. Material theses, forecasts and explanations are included; routine holdings lists, incidental statistics, company descriptions and boilerplate are excluded. Chart pixels were not inspected.

### 002-C06

**Base model yields ten-percent annual returns**

| Field | Assessment |
| --- | --- |
| Verdict | Too early |
| Type | forecast |
| Horizon | next decade (to November 2029) |
| Conditions | EPS grows 6% then 12%; specified payout and valuation |
| Author modality | model scenario |
| Asset or variable | AYI |
| Source blocks | 71, 73 |
| Thesis family | acuity-decade-return |

The stated ten-year endpoint is November 2029. Model arithmetic is not a realized result; interim earnings declines also show that a smooth trajectory should not be assumed.

**Direction:** See reason; no return inferred.

**Timing:** Original horizon retained: next decade (to November 2029)

**Mechanism:** Outcome evidence does not independently identify causation.

**Reviewer confidence:** medium

**Next test:** Calculate reinvested total return at the original endpoint and separately audit each model assumption.

**Outcome evidence:**

- [2020 annual report financials](https://media.corporate-ir.net/media_files/IROL/13/130194/AR2020/financials.html) | Acuity Brands | Verified in the audit

FY 2020 sales fell 9%, operating profit 24% and EPS 24%; operating cash flow rose 2%, cash exceeded debt, and free cash flow remained positive.

### 002-C11

**A broad correction can reduce Acuity twenty percent**

| Field | Assessment |
| --- | --- |
| Verdict | Right |
| Type | forecast |
| Horizon | Not specified |
| Conditions | Not specified |
| Author modality | possible |
| Asset or variable | AYI |
| Source blocks | 114, 115, 141, 143 |
| Thesis family | acuity-drawdown-risk |

Acuity fell from a $127.31 closing baseline on November 22, 2019 to $71.08 on March 23, 2020, a 44.17% drop. The broad-equity correction condition occurred. This verifies the warned capacity for a loss exceeding 20%, not the claim that the decline came solely from sentiment or that a warning was a short recommendation.

**Direction:** See independently checked outcomes and qualifications in reason.

**Timing:** No fixed endpoint supplied.

**Mechanism:** Outcome evidence does not independently identify causation.

**Reviewer confidence:** medium

**Outcome evidence:**

- [AYI daily price observations](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/AYI/history/) | Yahoo Finance | Verified in the audit

November 22, 2019 close $127.31; March 23, 2020 close $71.08, down 44.17%. Historical OHLC is split-normalized by the vendor, not a record of executed trades; prices exclude distributions.

### 002-C13

**Foreign sales do not diversify legal domicile**

| Field | Assessment |
| --- | --- |
| Verdict | Right |
| Type | explanation |
| Horizon | Not specified |
| Conditions | Not specified |
| Author modality | asserted |
| Asset or variable | Equities |
| Source blocks | 119 |
| Thesis family | jurisdiction-versus-sales |

Revenue geography and corporate legal domicile are distinct attributes. Subsequent Russian restrictions illustrate why instrument domicile and custody can dominate where sales occur. This is a structural distinction, not a return forecast.

**Direction:** Resolved as stated.

**Timing:** No fixed endpoint supplied.

**Mechanism:** Outcome evidence does not independently identify causation.

**Reviewer confidence:** medium

**Outcome evidence:**

- [On depositary receipt facilities of PJSC LUKOIL](https://www.lukoil.com/PressCenter/Pressreleases/Pressrelease/on-depositary-receipt-facilities-of-pjsc-lukoil) | Lukoil | 2022-05-05 | Verified in the audit

Russian law prohibited offshore depositary-receipt circulation. Lukoil announced ADR program termination effective December 30, 2022 and London listing cancellation June 6, with conversion arrangements for eligible holders.
